usedFor: Production List spots new film and TV productions, and Slack is where a sales or scouting team reacts. A “New Production Detected” in Production List can run “Send Interactive Message” in Slack, so each new production comes with buttons or a form.

bestTemplate.name: “New Production Detected” in Production List, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new production is a lead only someone has to decide on. “Send Interactive Message” carries buttons or a form to collect that answer from the team.

watchOut: “New Production Detected” is polling and can be filtered by type, stage and location, so set those or the channel gets every production. In 50agents a Slack post waits for approval.
